page_title: FUL 5-0 WHU | Fulham v West Ham 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+4' Bernd Leno doesn't have to worry about this one. Vladimir Coufal plays a pass into the feet of Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
90+4' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' 5 - 0 Goal! Harry Wilson passes the ball to the feet of Carlos Vinicius (Fulham), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 5:0.
87' Fulham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
85' Divin Mubama (West Ham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
82' Emerson (West Ham) trips an opposition player and Paul Tierney signals a foul.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Joao Palhinha as he is replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
79' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Alex Iwobi is replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham).
76' The attendance is 23988.
75' What was Fode Ballo-Toure (Fulham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
73' Bernd Leno leaps to intercept the corner kick from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).
72' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Fode Ballo-Toure (Fulham) replaces Antonee Robinson.
72' Substitution. Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) replaces Raul Jimenez.
70' Emerson (West Ham) jumps into a tackle and Paul Tierney signals a foul.
68' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

67' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Said Benrahma (West Ham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno pulls off a comfortable save.
66' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes it short.
66' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
65' Here is a change. Lucas Paqueta is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Said Benrahma (West Ham).
64' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Kurt Zouma will be replaced by Angelo Ogbonna (West Ham).
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Divin Mubama (West Ham) for Mohammed Kudus.

60' 4 - 0 Tom Cairney slides a pass towards Harry Wilson (Fulham) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the top left corner. The score is now 4:0.

56' Harry Wilson (Fulham) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Lukasz Fabianski guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
56' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) tries to find Alex Iwobi, but he puts too much power on the pass.
54' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

54' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Fulham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
50' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Fabianski punches the ball away.
48' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukasz Fabianski, who smothers the ball.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marco Silva gives a chance to Harry Wilson and Willian (Fulham) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Pablo Fornals (West Ham) is replaced by Emerson.
46' David Moyes makes a switch. Konstantinos Mavropanos is coming on in place of Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45+2' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. West Ham win a corner kick.
45+1' Yellow card. Joao Palhinha (Fulham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45+1' Half-chance! Alex Iwobi (Fulham) plays a pass into the box, but Lukasz Fabianski reacts well to snuff out the attack.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

40' 3 - 0 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the top left corner. The score is 3:0.
40' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

40' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fulham.

39' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham)'s poor effort is easily saved by Bernd Leno. He connects well with a cross, but mistimes it a little, and it heads low towards the middle of the target and straight into the grateful hands of the goalkeeper.
39' Pablo Fornals (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
38' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and it's Pablo Fornals (West Ham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
36' A clever short pass gives Tom Cairney (Fulham) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
31' 2 - 0 Willian (Fulham) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
31' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Lukasz Fabianski makes a save.

30' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
27' Willian (Fulham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
26' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Lukasz Fabianski comes off his line to gather the ball.
23' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post!
22' 1 - 0 Goooooal! Joao Palhinha beats his man and slings in a cross towards Raul Jimenez (Fulham), who evades his marker and plants a fine header inside the right post from close in. 1:0.
20' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
20' Willian (Fulham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
19' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
18' The corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is intercepted by Bernd Leno.
17' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
17' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. West Ham force their opponents to concede a corner.
16' Willian (Fulham) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Lukasz Fabianski is alert and denies him with a nice save.

14' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
13' An attempted cross from Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is cleared.
12' Good team movement sets up Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
10' Pablo Fornals (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
7' Bernd Leno reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) towards the roof of the net.

6' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Paul Tierney stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick is awarded to West Ham.
5' A cross from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
4' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bernd Leno intercepts the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fulham will have the kick-off.
Paul Tierney will officiate today.
